mainEntity.name: What types of kitchen lighting are available for an upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen lighting upgrades offer various options, including ambient, task, and accent lighting. Ambient lighting provides general illumination with fixtures like recessed lights or ceiling-mounted fixtures. Task lighting, such as under-cabinet lights or pendant lights over an island, focuses on specific work areas. Accent lighting highlights architectural features or decor. The best approach often involves layering these types to achieve a functional and aesthetically pleasing kitchen. We can help you select the right combination based on your kitchen's layout and your specific needs.
